name: Henry's Fork (Box Canyon)
blurb: Island Park Dam to Last Chance — a short basalt canyon on some of the most famous trout water in the West.

sections.notes: Launch at the Box Canyon boat ramp below Island Park Dam and take out at Last Chance. This is rocky moving water; releases and low water change the trip. Give wading anglers room and confirm the takeout before starting. Check current access and fishing rules before extending beyond Last Chance.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate published reach length from the guide currently linked by HFF. It is independent of the facility coordinates and is not a surveyed landing-to-landing distance. Channel choice and reservoir conditions can change the actual trip.

notices.title: Use the below-dam launch
notices.text: The Box Canyon boat ramp is a different facility from the Island Park Reservoir ramps and the hike-in campground access. This itinerary ends at Last Chance.
notices.sourceName: Henry’s Fork Foundation — upper-river access guide
